title: Kitchen Organization
text: Kitchen Organization. This does help with my kitchen organization, especially by the sink. However, it would be better if the edges or sides were a little taller. I have some long handled brushes that I use at the sink. They can't stand up in this because there isn't anything to prop up against. For shorter items, it's not a problem.

product_metadata.title: Sponge Holder for Kitchen Sink, Sink Caddy Kitchen Sink Organizer with Adjustable Partition, Stainless Steel Kitchen Sink Dish Sponge Holder with Removable Drain Tray -Kitchen Sink Storage Accessories
features: KITCHEN SINK ORGANIZER - The sink sponge holder with large space to store scrubbers, sponges, brushes, drain stoppers and more. Keeps sponges and dish brushes organized any time. Best kitchen sink storage accessory.

STAINLESS STEEL CONSTRUCTION - The sponge holder is built-in high-grade polished 304 stainless steel for long time usage. The sink sponge holder is fingerprint free, rustproof and will not become dented or cracked.

ADJUSTABLE PARTITION - The removable partition in the kitchen sink caddy can divide one large space to different 2 size spaces to easily store sink accessories of different sizes. Especially divide to hold sponges and brushes, you can also remove the partition to use as large open kitchen sink organizer.

REMOVABLE DRAIN PAN - Sink organizer features ventilation holes for quick drying, The detachable drip tray also easy to pull in and out, you can easily clean it up frequently to prevent waters dripping to the countertop.

SAVE SINK SPACE - The kitchen sponge holder is the best kitchen sink storage accessories,it can store sponges, brushes off the countertop and keep the sink space tidy and dry every day. The sponge holder sink caddy can be used in other areas like bathroom for cleaning items organization.
